title: Dentist moved to Thursday 4pm; two days later, when is it?
source: x-usage #6: answers the new time (Thursday 4pm), not the old Tuesday 3:45, and can say where it changed.

chat.goal: Tell Rosie Ava's dentist moved to Thursday at 4pm and get the calendar fixed.

judge: Rosie moves the event to Thursday 4pm (noting it clashes with Liam's swim and the playdate). Two days later she answers 'Thursday at 4' straight away, without the old time.
